Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear packet. A few things to keep the procurement funnel moving smoothly:

1) Full TIN verification: finance needs an unredacted TIN on the W-9 or an IRS/Bank letter that explicitly states the EIN. The redacted W-9 is fine for preliminary review but not sufficient for PO/ACH activation.
2) Signer authority: the notarized PDF is helpful; procurement needs a DocuSign-signed copy of our standard Vendor Signatory Affidavit (I can send a link) or a comparable corporate resolution.
3) PO timing: we can draft a PO while evidence is reviewed, but we cannot issue until finance clears tax identity.

If you can either: (A) submit the full W-9 via a secure DocuSign link, or (B) provide an IRS CP575 or a bank letter that states the EIN, that will usually satisfy our finance team.

I'll send the DocuSign link momentarily for the signatory affidavit. Marcus / Kim, looping you for the official evidence checklist and any preferred formats.

Thanks — Naomi

Thanks Naomi / Elena — quick finance checklist to make sure there are no surprises:

Acceptable items for EIN/TIN confirmation (any one of the following):
- Completed W-9 with full EIN (submitted via secure portal or DocuSign), OR
- IRS CP575 (confirmation of EIN issuance), OR
- Bank letter on bank letterhead that explicitly states the EIN and account owner (dated within 12 months).

Additional items required before PO issuance:
- Vendor W-9 on file with full EIN (not redacted).
- Completed ACH form (we'll send our template) + voided check or bank letter confirming account number.
- Signed Vendor Signatory Affidavit (DocuSign accepted) showing authorized signer for Redwood contract/PO amounts.

Payment terms and options:
- We prefer ACH for US vendors (Net 30 default). If Aurora requires wire, we need a completed wire form and remittance contact.

If you can get the unredacted W-9 or bank letter uploaded by EOD Thursday (10/7), we should be able to clear the PO in the following two business days.
